order_placement_is_free.meaning: submitting an order to the book incurs no fee

fees_charged_only_on_match.meaning: trading fees are applied only when orders are matched and executed

expiring_orders_supported.meaning: protocol accepts orders with expiration timestamps and removes expired ones with full maker refund without fees

attacker_advantage_obtained.meaning: attacker obtains an unfair advantage by systematically blocking other traders' POST_ONLY orders via short-expiration orders
attacker_advantage_obtained.checkpoint: after attacker places short-expiration orders and victims' POST_ONLY orders are blocked

assumptions: The attacker's short-expiration orders are placed at competitive prices around the spot price, flooding the book.
Victims' POST_ONLY orders are at the same price as the attacker's expiring orders.
Expired orders are removed with full refund to the maker without fees.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the attacker's expiring orders are POST_ONLY or another order type, nor the exact victim order price relative to attacker orders beyond 'same price'.

limitations: The selected impact 'unfair_advantage_attackers' is formalized as a Boolean observable; the report does not give a numeric definition of the advantage.
Other impacts (fee differential, market-making disruption) are handled in separate claim-generation passes and are not covered here.
The relation encodes the absence of the attacker's unfair advantage as the desired property under the stated preconditions.
